kept_share.description: Null until the band has at least 5 checks

recorded_share.title: Recorded Share
recorded_share.description: Share of the typer's test set in this band, null when not measured

recorded_accuracy.title: Recorded Accuracy
recorded_accuracy.description: How often the typer was right in this band on its test set, null when not measured

ai_class_id.title: Ai Class Id
ai_class_id.description: The AI call when the object was first decided, kept for as long as the decision exists. Reported by the client for cells and read from the result set for regions.

ai_score.title: Ai Score
ai_score.description: The AI call when the object was first decided, kept for as long as the decision exists. Reported by the client for cells and read from the result set for regions.

bands.title: Bands
bands.description: Bands split the calibrated confidence the reviewer was shown, saved with each cell decision. Agree keeps the call, disagree overturns it, not sure counts as neither.

unchecked_bands.title: Unchecked Bands
unchecked_bands.description: Bands that hold at least 5% of the typer's test set and have under 5 checks

overall_kept_share.title: Overall Kept Share
overall_kept_share.description: The share of calls kept, weighted by the typer's recorded band shares rather than by the calls the queue happened to show. Withheld until at least 20 calls are checked and every band holding at least 5% of the typer's test set has at least 5 checks. Always withheld for a typer with no recorded calibration.
